before.text: DeepState publishes Ukrainian recaptures late, so Vivaldi's May–June 2026 gains show up only in its August–September versions.

before.effect: at least 8 aircraft lost in a week; low-level penetration stopped
before.rationale: When the VKS went low in late February–early March 2022, MANPADS downed at least 8 Su-25/Su-30/Su-34 in a week; low-level penetrating sorties had stopped by April 2022.
Scatterable mines made night resupply through the breach lanes deadly in 2023.

before.effect: Ka-52s suffered disproportionately, often failing to dispense flares
before.rationale: Ka-52s led the gunships and suffered disproportionately; they often failed to dispense flares when engaged by MANPADS.
Rain and fog blinded Ukrainian drones before the Huliaipole infiltration.

before.effect: infiltrators struck at the exit; did not prevent the loss of Sudzha
before.rationale: At Sudzha in March 2025 the Ukrainian General Staff said the pipe infiltration was 'detected in a timely manner' and Air Assault Forces filmed the exit before artillery and HIMARS strikes; Ukraine still withdrew from Sudzha on 12 March 2025 as Rubikon cut its supply lines.

before.effect: up to 20 resupply runs per crew per day
before.rationale: With roads under Rubikon fibre-optic FPV attack, Kazhan bomber drones flew food, water, fuel and grenades around the clock.

before.effect: about 15 FPVs on one robot reported
before.rationale: Tactics catalogue (§3) lists "FPV swarms on UGVs" as a counter to "UGV casevac and resupply".

before.rationale: At about 500 km/h, jet Gerans are beyond current interceptor drones.

before.rationale: Jet Gerans complicate the work of mobile fire groups, which Ihnat says can no longer be relied on against them.

before.effect: Russian troops diverted to guard command posts
before.rationale: Reconnaissance mapped nodes whose loss would break control; strikes forced Russia to pull troops back to guard CPs.

before.text: The bavovniatko world architecture is per-chapter dioramas of 10–100 km plus a 2D country map, not one continuous country-scale 3D world.
A 32-bit float has about 1.6 cm of resolution at 200 km from the origin, so diorama-local origins keep f32 transforms precise enough and floating-origin machinery is not a v1 dependency.
bevy-clipmap's terrain self-shadowing horizon maps cost 360·W·H·4 bytes: 1.4 GB at 1k, prohibitive past about 8k.
In Bevy 0.19's many_cubes benchmark, 1.6 million PBR cube entities went from 49.5 ms to 18.8 ms per frame with culling (116,000 in view), and from 93.1 ms to 41.2 ms unculled.

Nearly all of bevy_weather's cost is the per-pixel cloud raymarch, with broken skies the most expensive; its CPU-rebuilt cloud-shadow texture costs about 1.5 ms at 64, 6 ms at 128 and 20 ms at 256, spread over frames.

before.markdown:
- **Target: Bevy 0.19 stable** (0.19.1, 2026-08-13) [src:bevy-releases] [src:bevy-0.19-release].
  Bevy 0.20.0 shipped on 2026-10-08, after this survey, following release candidates of 15 and
  28 September; the plugins below were checked against 0.19, so 0.19.1 stays pinned until they
  follow [src:crates-io-bevy].
- **World architecture: per-chapter dioramas plus a 2D country map**, not one continuous
  country-scale 3D world. Dioramas are 10–100 km; local origins keep `f32` transforms precise
  enough (a 32-bit float has about 1.6 cm of resolution at 200 km from origin), so floating-origin
  machinery is not a v1 dependency [src:big-space].
- **Visual target: sim-first, drab utilitarian.** Sensor looks (FLIR, night vision, FPV feed
  artefacts, radar scope) are first-class build items, not polish. No ready-made plugin exists for
  any of them; each is one fullscreen post-process system + shader, which Bevy 0.19 made simple
  (render passes are now plain ECS systems in the `Core3d`/`Core2d` schedules) [src:bevy-0.19-release].
- **Integration:** staged into the knowledge base; claim extraction and rendering follow later.

- **Mud season.** The wet autumn (100+ mm a month in September and October) produced the mud of Bakhmut's trench war [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-bakhmut-2022-23].
- **Key days.**
  - **20 Dec 2022** (Zelensky's visit): −7.4 to 0.8 °C, dry, 42% cloud, sunset 16:34.
  - **10–12 Jan 2023** (fall of Soledar): hard frost, −13.1 to −1.3 °C, winds to about 27 km/h, overcast by 12 Jan.
  - **6–7 Mar 2023** (withdrawal across the Bakhmutka): −5.2 to 5.6 °C, light snow on 7 Mar.
  - **10 May 2023** (the flank counterattack): 5.4–10.5 °C, 95% cloud, light rain.
  - **20 May 2023** (Prigozhin's declaration): 10.8–25.8 °C, dry, sunrise 04:41, sunset 20:07.
- **April rain.** Milbloggers reported in April that heavy rain let only tracked vehicles use the country roads [src:isw-2023-04-21-roca]. April had rain on 17 days [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-bakhmut-2022-23].

1. **Zelensky in Bakhmut (20 Dec 2022) and the flag in Congress (21 Dec).**
   - **The visit.** On day 300 of the invasion Zelensky goes to "frontline positions of one of the mechanized brigades … on the approaches to the city" and hands out awards [src:president-2022-zelensky-bakhmut-visit-awards]. He leaves before the visit is announced [src:bbc-2022-bachega-zelensky-visits-bakhmut]. The soldiers give him a flag "to pass on" [src:president-2022-address-indomitable-bakhmut].
   - **The flag.** The next day he presents it to Congress: "Let this flag stay with you" [src:pbs-2022-freking-zelensky-dc-visit]. It is a battle flag signed by the defenders [src:bbc-2022-chatterjee-zelensky-visit-russia-reaction].
   - **Weather.** The visit day is frosty and dry, with sunset at 16:34 [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-bakhmut-2022-23].
2. **The salt town (4–16 Jan 2023).**
   - **The streets.** Wagner fights street by street through Soledar. A Wagner fighter is filmed at the Artemsil plant, while a Ukrainian correspondent poses at the salt mine in the north-west [src:isw-2023-01-07-roca].
   - **The fall.** The town falls in hard frost, −13 °C on 10 Jan [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-bakhmut-2022-23].
   - **The quarrel.** It ends with the Russian MoD's announcement that leaves Wagner out, and a correction six hours later [src:isw-2023-01-13-roca].
3. **Withdrawal across the Bakhmutka (3–7 Mar 2023).**
   - **The bridges.** Two bridges go down on 3 Mar, one over the Bakhmutka and one on the Khromove road [src:isw-2023-03-03-roca].
   - **The east bank.** Over four days Ukraine pulls back across the river, and the river becomes the front [src:isw-2023-03-07-roca].
   - **The flag.** Wagner hangs its flag on the T-34 monument in the east [src:isw-2023-03-06-roca].
   - **The order.** Zelensky meanwhile orders reinforcements in [src:isw-2023-03-06-roca].
4. **AZOM (10–28 Mar 2023).**
   - **The assault.** Wagner assaults the built-up metals plant, including its "underground sections" [src:isw-2023-03-10-roca] [src:isw-2023-03-13-roca].
   - **The fall.** It takes about two and a half weeks [src:isw-2023-03-29-roca]. A Ukrainian missile then strikes the Russian-held plant [src:isw-2023-04-03-roca].
5. **The flag on city hall (night of 2 Apr 2023).**
   - **The flag.** Prigozhin raises a Russian flag in front of the city administration building, inscribed to the killed milblogger Maksim Fomin.
   - **The claim.** He declares Bakhmut "legally" taken, though Ukrainians still hold the west [src:isw-2023-04-03-roca] [src:aljazeera-2023-wagner-legal-control-bakhmut].
   - **Three weeks later.** The building is "completely flattened … flags literally on top of the rubble" [src:kyivindependent-2023-farrell-bakhmut-flanks-hold].
6. **The road of life.**
   - **The run.** Vehicles weave at near top speed between craters on the last roads in, through Khromove and Ivanivske. Satellite imagery shows "thousands of shell holes" at the bend nearest the Russians [src:kyivindependent-2023-farrell-bakhmut-flanks-hold]. Drivers make dawn dashes "on tires frayed to almost nothing" [src:businessinsider-2023-baker-jankowicz-unyielding-city].
   - **The trench fight.** The 3rd Assault Brigade's trench fight to free the road from fire control is filmed on bodycams [src:youtube-2023-3oshbr-road-of-life-trench-battle].
7. **Prigozhin among the corpses (4–5 May 2023).** In front of rows of dead Wagner fighters, Prigozhin curses Shoigu and Gerasimov and sets a 10 May deadline to leave the city. Four days later he backs down [src:isw-2023-05-05-roca] [src:isw-2023-05-09-roca].
8. **The flank strikes back (9–18 May 2023).**
   - **The breakthrough.** The 3rd Assault Brigade breaks the Russian 72nd Motor Rifle Brigade south-west of the city, and Prigozhin says the 72nd "fled" [src:pravda-2023-3rd-assault-72nd-flees] [src:isw-2023-05-10-roca].
   - **The reservoir.** Russian soldiers are filmed running from Ukrainian artillery on the Berkhivka reservoir [src:isw-2023-05-12-roca].
   - **The other side's view.** Prigozhin admits that he can no longer encircle anything [src:isw-2023-05-18-roca].
9. **The last blocks: the Nest and the Airplane (17–21 May 2023).**
   - **The barrage.** Wagner tanks and artillery pound "the last block of the high-rise buildings" at the western entrance [src:euromaidanpress-2023-frontline-wagnerites-high-rises].
   - **The declaration.** Prigozhin declares victory at the last multi-storey block near the MiG-17 monument. The monument itself was blown up in March [src:isw-2023-05-20-roca] [src:pravda-2023-mazurenko-mig17-monument-destroyed].
   - **The holdout.** Ukrainians still hold the "Airplane" area and the south-western outskirts for weeks [src:euromaidanpress-2023-zoria-maliar-airplane-area] [src:isw-2023-06-01-roca].
10. **Coda: Andriivka and Klishchiivka (14–17 Sep 2023).** The 3rd Assault Brigade encircles Andriivka. The 80th Air Assault Brigade, the 5th Assault Brigade and the police "Liut" brigade clear Klishchiivka on the heights [src:militarnyi-2023-andriivka-taken] [src:militarnyi-2023-klishchiivka-cleared].

- **Win band.**
  - **Hard conditions.** Vuhledar is still held at 31 Mar 2023, and the Russian line ends no more than about 2–4 km closer: Pavlivka, Mykilske and parts of the dachas fall [src:isw-2023-03-05-roca] [src:novayagazeta-2023-ukmod-raam].
  - **Armour scoring band** for Russian vehicles destroyed or abandoned in the main battle:
    - floor of about 30 (UK MoD's single incident; the 13+12 footage)
    - middle of about 100 (Oryx, 8–10 Feb, Avdiivka and Vuhledar)
    - ceiling of about 130 (Ukrainian claim)
  - The debrief names each claimant [src:reuters-2023-ukmod-vuhledar-dozens] [src:insider-2023-oryx-103-vehicles] [src:politico-2023-melkozerova-155th-brigade].
- **Self-running script.** The AI should repeat the historical pattern:
  - probes on 24–27 Jan
  - a first-week drive from Mykilske towards the T-0524
  - the large mechanised push of 6 Feb
  - repeated column attempts to about 15 Feb
  - armour exhausted by late February, then infantry waves into March
  - The scripted events are the arrival of the Alga battalion, the 136th Motor Rifle Brigade in March, and Shoigu's "at any cost" order. Sources: [src:isw-2023-01-25-roca] [src:isw-2023-02-04-roca] [src:forbes-2023-axe-vuhledar-halt] [src:nyt-2023-kramer-epic-tank-battle] [src:isw-2023-03-10-roca] [src:isw-2023-03-05-roca].
- **Core mechanic: the kill zone.** Pre-planned minefields with a deliberately clear road, ATGM teams in tree lines and pre-registered artillery. The player's levers are:
  - where to leave lanes
  - when to spring the trap, waiting for the column to commit
  - RAAM missions onto cleared corridors or behind columns
  - Source: [src:nyt-2023-kramer-epic-tank-battle] [src:forbes-2023-axe-minefield-raam] [src:novayagazeta-2023-ukmod-raam]
- **Observation as a resource.** High-rise OPs and quadcopters convert the open plain into a fire-control advantage, and losing an OP or a drone should degrade fire accuracy [src:kyivpost-2023-korshak-vuhledar-marines] [src:cnn-2023-lister-vuhledar-turkeys]. Russian TOS-1A and air strikes on the blocks are the counter [src:isw-2023-01-27-roca].
- **Scarcity.** Shells, RAAM rounds and ATGMs are limited, which is Zaluzhnyi's binding constraint, and HIMARS is a rare high-value call [src:isw-2023-02-11-roca] [src:nyt-2023-kramer-epic-tank-battle]. The player should be tempted to over-spend on the first columns.
- **Russian AI behaviour.** Columns in single file along known dirt roads, smoke screens, a plow lead and poor reaction to mines. Mobilised crews panic and leave the road [src:forbes-2023-axe-vuhledar-halt] [src:cnn-2023-lister-vuhledar-turkeys] [src:isw-2023-02-13-roca].
- **Weather and pacing.** The window runs from mud (Nov) through frozen ground (late Jan – mid-Feb, frost to −11 °C) to thaw (late Feb – Mar) [src:open-meteo-historical-archive]. Daylight is about 07:50–17:40 in early February. Reserves arriving in late January are the Ukrainian "save" that ends Russia's window of opportunity [src:isw-2023-02-11-roca].
- **Epilogue framing.** The debrief can show the 2024 fall by envelopment of the flanks (Prechystivka, Vodiane), with glide bombs and an unrotated brigade. The town that columns could not take frontally fell to its flanks [src:kyivpost-2024-kostezh-why-lost] [src:isw-2024-09-30-roca].

**Weather and light.** ERA5 reanalysis for 48.14 N 37.74 E, Kyiv local time; reanalysis, not observations [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-avdiivka-2023-24].
- **10–12 Oct 2023 (the first wave).** Dry and mostly clear (cloud 13–55%), lows about 0 °C, highs 7–12 °C. Sunrise about 06:40, sunset about 17:50.
- **19–20 Oct (the second wave).** Dry, warming to 18 °C, overcast by 20 Oct, with wind gusting to 33 km/h.
- **Late October to November.** Rain on 26 and 28 Oct. Milbloggers blamed rain for the lull on 26 Oct [src:wikipedia-battle-of-avdiivka]. In November mud made many roads impassable and fog cut aerial reconnaissance [src:isw-2023-11-13-roca]. Morning fog gave windows for infiltration [src:euromaidan-2023-avdiivka-rain-fog].
- **19–27 Nov.** First snow (about 2 cm on 19 Nov), a frost to −7 °C on 23 Nov, then 25 mm of rain on 25–26 Nov and gusts to 38 km/h on 27 Nov. Barabash spoke of "blowing snow and high winds" [src:kyivpost-2023-korshak-factory-district].
- **January 2024.** Mostly around or below freezing and overcast, with light snow (sampled 11, 15 and 20 Jan). Kirby expected the frozen ground of late January and February to favour mechanised attack [src:isw-2023-12-21-roca].
- **5–13 Feb.** Snow on 5 Feb (about 4 cm), then a thaw: 15 mm of rain on 10 Feb and highs of 9–14 °C by 11–14 Feb, under 100% cloud. Fog on 10–11 Feb [src:euromaidanpress-2024-aerial-bombs-encirclement]. Barabash said the ground was too soft for tanks [src:wikipedia-battle-of-avdiivka].
- **15–17 Feb (the withdrawal).** A dry hard frost returns: lows of −2 to −6 °C, highs of 2–3 °C, mostly overcast. Sunrise about 07:35, sunset about 17:50. The Zenit walk-out was "pitch black" [src:pravda-2024-kyrylenko-last-days-avdiivka]. A Zenit veteran says it was "foggy" at the time evacuation should have happened [src:pravda-2024-kyrylenko-last-days-avdiivka].

**Weather and light.**
- *Spring 2025.* Mechanised assaults resumed by mid-April 2025 as the ground hardened [src:spire-2025-soil-moisture].
- *The Dobropillia breach, 7–14 August 2025.* It came in dry, clear summer weather, 25–30 °C with little rain, and sunrise about 05:20 local [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-pokrovsk-2025-26]. Foliage and thermal blankets, not fog, hid the infiltrators [src:suspilne-2025-ivantsiv-how-breakthrough].
- *October 2025.* The armoured attacks on Shakhove were timed to rain and morning fog (6, 9 and 13 October) [src:isw-2025-10-14-roca].
- *The November fog, 5–12 November.* ERA5 shows overcast, near-saturated air (daily mean relative humidity 86–96%, light wind), and our fog proxy counts 6–10 hours a day on 5–7, 10 and 12 November. November 2025 had the most fog-proxy hours of the winter: 84, against 52 in December and 14 in January [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-pokrovsk-2025-26]. Reported effects:
  - more than 300 Russians got in [src:euromaidan-2025-axe-foggy-advance];
  - the column of cars and bikes drove in on 9 November [src:bbc-2025-abdurasulov-fog-pokrovsk];
  - wet weather disadvantaged light FPVs [src:aljazeera-2025-psaropoulos-pokrovsk];
  - up to 10 infiltrators a day got in on sunny days and 30–40 on rainy ones [src:hromadske-2025-butsko-encirclement-myrnohrad].
- *1–2 December 2025.* Overcast, 4–6 °C, with 7 mm of rain on 2 December [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-pokrovsk-2025-26], during the Russian claim and the turtle-tank assault in fog [src:euromaidanpress-2025-axe-turtle-tanks-myrnohrad].
- *Light.* Sunset about 16:40 in December, giving about 8.5 hours of daylight [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-pokrovsk-2025-26].
- *January 2026.* The fall came in deep cold: −15 °C on 17 and 20 January and −18 °C on 4 February, with a thin snow cover of 3–7 cm [src:open-meteo-2026-era5-pokrovsk-2025-26]. The 7th Corps said the cold caused Russian hypothermia and frostbite losses [src:united24-2026-litnarovych-winter]. Icing hampers fibre-optic FPVs [src:euromaidan-2026-kossov-icy-fibre].
